title: Competitor profile michelangelo
dod: Implement forms and client rules matching backend. Shared contract: children sex nullable 'M'|'F', member_type not null 'recreational'|'competitor' default recreational, competition_class nullable 'A'|'B', weight_category_id nullable text FK. Read-only public.weight_categories with id text, age_category text, sex text, signed_kg integer, sort_order integer. public.competition_classes with id text A/B. Age codes rev_pioneers (6–7), younger_pioneers (8–9), older_pioneers (10–11), cadets (12–14), juniors (15–17), seniors (18+); Belgrade year minus birth year. ID can be stable age:sex:signed_kg. Weights M/F both: REV and younger [-19,-21,-23,-25,-27,-29,-31,-33,-36,-39,-43,43]; older [-27,-30,-33,-36,-40,-44,-48,-52,-57,57]; cadets M [-33,-37,-41,-45,-49,-53,-57,-61,-65,65], F [-29,-33,-37,-41,-44,-47,-51,-55,-59,59]; juniors M [-45,-48,-51,-55,-59,-63,-68,-73,-78,78], F [-42,-44,-46,-49,-52,-55,-59,-63,-68,68]; seniors M [-54,-58,-63,-68,-74,-80,-87,87], F [-46,-49,-53,-57,-62,-67,-73,73]. Use confirmed server Belgrade year passed through existing Settings today. New child requires Pol (Muški/Ženski) and Tip člana, existing blank sex editable. Main group always required; only competitor can select optional extra competition group, class A/B and filtered weight. Show auto calculated Serbian age label, weight/classes sourced from repository catalogs. Label stale weights for reselection; clear incompatible selections when changing sex or birth date. For grandfathered recreational child retain existing competition group and show warning, offer explicit removal once live competition assignments have been closed/cancelled; allow changing to competitor and unrelated saves. When changing competitor to recreational clear competition fields and list blocking live competition assignments, pointing to schedule. Child list type badges and filter. Terms and attendance substitute UI cannot newly enroll recreational in competition while preserving existing rows. Keep medical and notes. No SQL, Git, remote writes. Run typecheck/lint/units. End DONE.
